about: Fred RS on deep intraday charts (2026-11-28): SP:SPX's extended-hours grid starts at the chart's first bar (plus the 1,000 rows before it), so a deep index store never passes the run's 32,768-bar HISTORY ceiling, and a missing chart bar stays the hole it was.

mutants.mutant: the grid is laid over the store's whole depth again (no `from`)
the rows before the chart's first bar are dropped (a hole at the chart's start reads as a depth gap)
